privacy.headline: Respect for your information.
body: Draft privacy notice for owner review. This preview represents L&C Real Estate Investment Group using customer-provided information.

When activated, the inquiry form sends your name, email, phone, investment interest, budget preference, property type, message and consent to RS WebFactory for business inquiry processing. Accepted inquiries are stored in PostgreSQL and notifications use SendGrid. Delivery is currently awaiting activation approval. Do not enter payment details, account numbers or sensitive financial information.
Phone and email links open your own calling or email application. Communications you choose to send are handled outside this website by the relevant providers and the business.
Myndy AI phone/chat, payment processing, customer lookup and marketing subscriptions are not enabled here. No customer contact information is used for tracking or automatic signup.

The hosting provider may process technical access information to serve and protect the site. Before launch, the business must confirm its data controller details, retention policy, service providers and applicable privacy rights.
For privacy questions, contact Larry Lafrance at the customer-provided email address below. This notice requires final business approval before public launch.
